connector.name: StudioMeyer Academy
connector.registryDescription: Free Memory-First AI Operator course as an MCP server. Bundled curriculum, no account needed.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.studiomeyer.academy over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-academy. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.studiomeyer. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ACADEMY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Academy API key from studiomeyer.academy/dashboard/keys. Without it: free account-free mode (full curriculum). With it: adds progress/quizzes/certificates over stdio.
